attributes.composition: rich in Nb, Mo, Ta; 10.6% Ti and 3.9% Ni solid-dissolved

evidence.quote: The matrix phase of BCC is dendritic distributed, rich in elements such as Nb, Mo, Ta, and at the same time 10.6 % Ti and 3.9 % Ni are solid-dissolved.

attributes.composition: rich in Ti and Ni, almost no Mo, part of Ti replaced by Ta and Nb

evidence.quote: The TiNi grain boundary phase of B2 structure is rich in Ti and Ni elements, and contains almost no Mo, and part of Ti is replaced by Ta and Nb.

attributes.morphology: trigonal structure, distributed around matrix phase, small amount of bulk

evidence.quote: The XB phase of the trigonal structure is mainly distributed around the matrix phase, with a small amount of bulk distribution, containing about 40 % Ni element.

attributes.composition: FCC structure, part of Ti replaced by Ta and Nb

evidence.quote: The Ti2Ni phase of the FCC structure is distributed in bulk with a small number, and the part of Ti is also replaced by Ta and Nb.
the as-cast grain size distribution of NbMoTaTiNi high-entropy alloy is large, and the average grain size is 5.62 µm.
the BCC phase is fused into a cellular crystal, and there is no dendrite morphology.
the XB phase is re-precipitated, which is distributed in a lath shape
with the increase of the annealing temperature, the grains grow significantly and become more uniform, increasing from 8.91 µm to 19.12 µm.
The compressive yield strength at room temperature can reach 1728Mpa
the ultimate strength is as high as 2753 MPa
the strain is 21.75 %
the tensile strength is 1205Mpa
After annealing at 1200 ℃ , the compressive plasticity of the alloy is as high as 33.55 %, an increase of 54.3 %.
from 620.5HV in as-cast state to 532.2HV at 1200 ℃ .
when annealed at 600 ℃ , the hardness value reached the highest value of 629.8HV.
only 0.815 % in the as-cast state, but its ultimate strength can reach 1205 MPa.
the room temperature tensile properties of the NbMoTaTiNi high-entropy alloy after heat treatment at 600 ℃ are also unsatisfactory, only 910 Mpa
and the elongation is only 0.631 %
This is mainly due to the effect of fine grain strengthening and lattice distortion.
the effect of fine grain strengthening and lattice distortion
This is mainly due to the effect of fine grain strengthening and lattice distortion.
The matrix phase of BCC is dendritic distributed, rich in elements such as Nb, Mo, Ta, and at the same time 10.6 % Ti and 3.9 % Ni are solid-dissolved.
The TiNi grain boundary phase of B2 structure is rich in Ti and Ni elements, and contains almost no Mo, and part of Ti is replaced by Ta and Nb.
The XB phase of the trigonal structure is mainly distributed around the matrix phase, with a small amount of bulk distribution, containing about 40 % Ni element.
The Ti2Ni phase of the FCC structure is distributed in bulk with a small number, and the part of Ti is also replaced by Ta and Nb.
the XB phase disappears, and the BCC phase dendrites fuse and grow.
the BCC phase is fused into a cellular crystal, and there is no dendrite morphology.
All of the above have fully confirmed the strengthening effect of fine grains on the strength and hardness of NbMoTaTiNi high-entropy alloys formed by SLM technology.
